answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let reputation grow only through verified work, like a vine climbing a knoll one tendril at a time. A sybil spawning a thousand identities must fund a thousand stakes, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught faking attestations. Honest agents crossing the canyon of distrust pay once and keep their bond; attackers pay per identity and lose it all, so fake agents cost more than the fraud can earn.
